newsitem.title: UK: Expeditors names European sales directors.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors names European sales directors.

text.p: Seattle based logistics company Expeditors International of Washington said it has appointed two sales directors who will be based at Heathrow, London.
Wayne Holbrook now UK sales and marketing manager will be responsible for developing global sales between Europe and the Americas, Africa and the Middle East.

Dave Emerson moves up from Far Eastern development director to take responsibility for developing business between Europea and the Far East, Indian sub-continent and Australasia. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
